items.title: Stock market holiday for Ambedkar Jayanti 2026: Are NSE, BSE and MCX open or closed on April 14? Check now
items.description: NSE Holidays 2026: Domestic stock exchanges NSE and BSE will be shut for trading on Tuesday due to Dr. Ambedkar Jayanti holiday. There will be no trading on NCDEX, while MCX will resume trading in the evening session.

items.title: Storm Rising! Safe transit for D-Street ends fast, short covering limits losses
items.description: Nifty fell 207 points or 0.9% to close at 23,842. Sensex declined 702 points or 0.9% to end at 76,847. Both Nifty and Sensex had declined as much as 2% during the day, but traders covered some of their bearish bets ahead of the financial markets holiday on Tuesday.
